full_prompt_en: The image is a square densely drawn comic-fantasy illustration dominated by the enormous face of a horned magenta creature at the left. One half-lidded yellow eye stares outward beneath a pale teal brow. Its broad pink nose, purple shadowed cheek, and sweeping teal moustache fill most of the foreground. One curved horn rises out of the upper left, partly cut by the frame. Behind this face, a second purple creature with pointed ears and a yellow eye emerges from the middle. Small figures and skull-like shapes appear among the overlapping forms at the right and lower edge. A ribbon of blazing yellow and orange flame curls diagonally from the lower center toward the upper right, separating the cool purple-magenta bodies from a hot decorative background. Two small dark-haired figures appear near the upper-right area, surrounded by smoke-like swirls. The whole scene is crowded but carefully tiered: giant foreground face, middle creature, and tiny distant forms. Heavy black ink contours hold the shapes together. Inside them, many short scratches, hatches, scales, and swirling ornament marks make the surface lively. The palette is deliberately intense: hot pink, magenta, violet, yellow, orange, and pale teal. Shadows are drawn with black and deep purple rather than smooth airbrushed gradient. Light seems to radiate from the flame and yellow background, touching edges of noses, horns, and curled hair. The composition pushes beyond all four sides, suggesting a larger illustrated world outside the crop. Its mood is mischievous and slightly threatening, with exaggerated expression, compressed scale, and energetic linework turning a complex collision of shapes into a vivid posterlike image.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、密集线绘的漫画奇幻插画，左侧一张巨大的有角洋红生物面孔占主导。一只半睁的黄眼从浅青眉下向外望。宽阔粉红鼻、紫影面颊和横扫的青色胡须填满前景大半。一只弯角从左上升起，局部被画边切断。这张脸后，第二只尖耳、黄眼的紫色生物从中央露出。右侧与下缘的重叠形状里出现小人影和骷髅般形体。一条灼亮的黄橙火焰从下方中央斜卷向右上，将冷紫与洋红身体和炎热装饰底面分开。两名深发小人物出现在右上附近，被烟雾般的卷纹围住。全景拥挤，却有仔细的层次：巨大前景脸、中间生物和微小远处形体。厚黑墨轮廓把形状锁在一起。内部许多短划痕、排线、鳞片和卷曲装饰笔痕使表面活跃。配色有意强烈：热粉、洋红、紫、黄、橙与浅青。阴影由黑与深紫线画出，不是平滑喷枪渐层。光仿佛从火焰和黄背景辐射，触及鼻、角与卷发的边缘。构图从四边继续溢出，暗示裁切外仍有更大插画世界。氛围淘气又略带威胁，夸张表情、压缩尺度和有力线工把复杂的形状碰撞变成鲜明海报式画面。
style_prompt_en: Dense comic-fantasy illustration uses exaggerated scale, heavy ink contours, and swirling ornamental marks. Hot magenta, violet, yellow, orange, and pale teal create a clashing but organized palette. Huge cropped shapes anchor the foreground, while smaller figures and motifs nest in the gaps to establish several layers. Shadow is built from black hatching, scratchy lines, and deep colored patches rather than smooth gradient. Bright curling bands carry light and motion across the frame. Textures stay visibly hand drawn even inside saturated color. The result is crowded, playful, and a little menacing, with clear large silhouettes keeping the abundant detail legible.
style_prompt_zh: 密集的漫画奇幻插画运用夸张尺度、厚墨轮廓和回旋装饰笔痕。热洋红、紫、黄、橙与浅青形成相撞却有组织的配色。巨大的裁切形状锚定前景，较小人影和图案嵌在缝隙里，建立多层空间。阴影由黑排线、毛糙线条和深色斑块构成，而非平滑渐层。明亮的卷曲色带将光与运动带过画面。即使在饱和色内部，肌理仍明显为手绘。效果拥挤、活泼且略带威胁，以清楚的大剪影使丰盛细节可读。
theme_en: A huge magenta horned face looming beside smaller creatures and curling yellow flames
theme_zh: 巨大的洋红色角面孔压在小生物与卷曲黄焰旁
name: Dan Hipp
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
